diagnosis: The failed proof differentiated scalar components, while the available Maxwell lemmas state derivatives of vector-valued fields followed by component evaluation. It also left the custom time derivative opaque, so the Fréchet derivative rules never expanded the differentiated Ampère and Gauss equations. Normalize componentwise derivatives with smoothness-aware simplification, unfold `Time.deriv`, expand the finite sums and linear operations, commute mixed derivatives, and then combine the two differentiated equations.
proof_body:
by
  have hmax :=
    (isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h
  have hamp :
      (fun s => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) s) =
        fun s =>
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *
              ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
            (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    simpa (disch := fun_prop) using
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h s x i
  have hamp' := congrArg (fun f : Time → ℝ => ∂ₜ f t) hamp
  have hgauss :
      (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
        fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y / 𝓕.ε₀ := by
    funext y
    simpa (disch := fun_prop) using (hmax t y).1
  have hgauss' := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => ∂[i] f x) hgauss
  simp (disch := fun_prop)
      [Time.deriv, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
        fderiv_fun_sub, fderiv_const_mul, fderiv_fun_sum,
        SpaceTime.time_deriv_space_deriv_commute,
        time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out)),
        Space.deriv_commute, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hamp' hgauss'
  linear_combination (norm := field_simp [FreeSpace.c_sq]) hamp' -
    (𝓕.c ^ 2) * hgauss'
